title: A check encodes the contract, and a veto must be gated

lintRule.summary: A code check can veto a candidate and route to a replacement that a selector prefers, with no gate comparing the two

templateDiff.text: skills/micro-harness: add to the "code checks" section. (1) Every heuristic code check ships a self-test: a documented-legal change, cited from the task contract, must pass it. (2) A selector prefers the earliest candidate that passes the GATING checks; a heuristic check may only add evidence. (3) A repair prompt may not forbid what a named defect class requires (a wrong-default fix changes a default value). (4) The construction probe set covers each defect operator the task family names.

probeRequirement: A documented-legal edit of each kind the contract names must pass the check (documented_legal_edit probe).
caveats: Rules written from these artifacts: firing on them describes them and predicts nothing until it fires on workflows built after the rule was frozen (docs/LINT.md).
Reaches the constructor only through a new kit hash; held until after EX1 so CX3 and EX1 do not share a moving kit (owner decision 4, default).
